description: JVM classes and nominal checks slice (ISSUE-0095). JVM-only fixtures that run the real DEAL frontend (lexer → parser → name resolver → type checker) → real JvmBackend codegen → javac subprocess → java subprocess executing the emitted artifact (the harness fails a fixture whose codegen or JVM execution is bypassed). Covered forms: local class declarations with defaulted primitive fields, object-literal class construction (defaults applied per construction, provided fields in literal evaluation order, construction before the class declaration — checker hoisting), primitive field reads and writes (int/number/boolean/string), fresh instances per construction, module-level (load-time) construction, the same-module nominal runtime checks at the slice's one untyped boundary (a table field read in a class-typed contextual target — success for a genuine instance, E8001 for a plain table value, for a null value, and for an identically-shaped sibling class, pinning nominal — never structural — identity), and one frontend compile-error gate rejected before any backend runs (E3001 nominal A→B assignment). Spec v1.1 classes are sealed records with no methods and no constructors, so the method surface is empty: the only callables are the module functions the earlier function-slice fixtures cover (methods where supported = none, documented in the review evidence).

tests.name: jvm-class-construction-defaults
tests.description: A local class with defaulted primitive fields constructed from an empty object literal receives every default (p.x = 10, p.y = 20)

tests.name: jvm-class-construction-provided-fields
tests.description: Provided fields override defaults in an object-literal construction; omitted fields keep their defaults

tests.name: jvm-class-field-read-write
tests.description: Declared primitive class fields are readable and writable: p.x and p.y are read, mutated, and read back (1+5=6, 2+2=4 → 64)

tests.name: jvm-class-primitive-field-types
tests.description: All four primitive field types flow through construction and reads: int, number, boolean, and string fields keep their provided values

tests.name: jvm-class-fresh-instances-per-construction
tests.description: Defaults are applied per construction, never shared: mutating one instance's field leaves a second instance's field at its default (7 + 0 = 7)

tests.name: jvm-class-module-level-construction
tests.description: A module-level (load-time) class construction runs in the static initializer, and a construction before the class declaration resolves through checker hoisting (origin.x * 10 + origin.y = 12)

tests.name: jvm-class-construction-evaluation-order
tests.description: Provided field values evaluate left-to-right in literal order even when the literal order differs from the field declaration order: tag(second) prints before tag(first), and each value still lands in its declared field

tests.name: jvm-class-nominal-check-success
tests.description: A genuine Box instance crossing the slice's untyped boundary (a table field read in a class-typed contextual target) passes the runtime nominal check and its field reads back (41 + 1 = 42)

tests.name: jvm-class-nominal-check-failure-table
tests.description: A plain table value crossing the class-typed boundary fails the runtime nominal check with E8001 (expected class instance) — never a silent cast

tests.name: jvm-class-nominal-check-failure-null
tests.description: A null value crossing the class-typed boundary fails the runtime nominal check with E8001 (expected class instance)

tests.name: jvm-class-same-shape-nominal-failure
tests.description: Identically-shaped sibling classes stay nominally distinct at runtime: an A instance crossing a B-typed boundary fails with E8001 (expected instance of B, got A) — identity is nominal, never structural

tests.name: jvm-class-frontend-nominal-assignment-error
tests.description: A direct A→B assignment between identically-shaped classes is a frontend compile error (E3001) rejected before any backend — nominal typing is enforced statically too
